requirement_history.applicability: Issue282 specifically carries combined branch+K common ground0.5mohm and railtransfer1mohm through proposed architecture. requirement_history.comparison_interpretation: GH0.06/0.10ohm two-contact bound exceeds expanded architecture budget, but is not a violation of original0.5mohm plane-only criterion. Both retain limits and require distinct acceptance accounting.
requirement_history.original_domain: 0.5mohm combined J-or-P plusK AGND spreading/neck including vias/sharednecks; 1mohm railplane. Wire/termination/contact terms added separately by producer. Original GH path explicitly excludes commonPCB resistance.
